name: map-globe-inset
title: Map Globe Inset
description: Newsreel globe with concentric rings, spinning continents, plane pass behind the disk, then switchboard still plate. Seek-safe SVG/GSAP + stills only (no MP4 wrapper). Inspired by Moving Image Archive, Our Shrinking World, 1946 (Animated Maps) - not affiliated; code recreation. Fidelity ceilings: angular coasts, film grain approximation, SVG plane silhouette (not photoreal), radial lighting vs physical globe, switchboard as still.
